facts.fact: The Ministry of Finance's reform progress report for 2025 states that "PFM Smart", a web-based, real-time accounting system, was rolled out across all 21 local councils; it does not say how the council offices are connected.

The Ministry of Finance states that the web-based, real-time accounting system PFM Smart was rolled out across all 21 local councils (21 of 21) in the 2025 reporting year; the figure counts councils working in the system, not a stated count of connected offices.
The Ministry of Finance lists among its 2025 achievements the rollout of the web-based, real-time accounting system PFM Smart across all 21 local councils; the report gives the year only.
